label: D2 after a1 led to S2 (rare a1 transition)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the agent chose a1 and was taken to S2, i.e. the rare transition for a1 (in_action=1, in_state=2). Never fires at D1/GO, never after a1->S1, a2->S2 or a2->S1 (19 stray steps). Recall/mass recall is about 1.0 but precision is only about 0.46: it is silent on about half of a1->S2R steps. Rate is much lower late in the episode (about 0.1% of steps in trials 90-99 vs about 2.5% early), so restricting to ep_trial<80 raises F1 only slightly (0.63 to 0.68). Activations are concentrated where S1 is the good state (87% of mass) and in middle value-head bins, with none at the highest values. Adding prev_reward, stay, the previous state, or a value threshold did not clearly separate active from inactive cases, so the on/off choice within a1->S2R is left unexplained (it may carry its information in magnitude). All variables in the predicate are observed at D2.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 8 (9 = most a1) (+7.62), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 7 (9 = most a1) (+4.95), phase=D2 & this=a1 S2 (+3.37), phase=D2 & ep_dec=1 (+2.37), phase=D2 & ep_dec=0 (+2.20), phase=D2 & value_bin=decile 3 (9 = highest) (+2.15). Lower it: ep_bucket=5 (-3.62), state=1 (-3.26), in_state=1 (-3.25), value_bin=decile 8 (9 = highest) (-3.09).
